bio: There are plenty of surprises on offer here, from the sleek, modern look of the room that hides behind the traditional red exterior to the lovely terrace secreted out the back. Wherever you sit, there’s a convivial feel, with the wallet-friendly prices only adding to the cheery mood. The concise menu showcases fresh produce from the region, and this local philosophy extends to the bar, where homemade ingredients feature in the soft drinks and cocktails. The creatively topped flatbreads are perfect for flying visits, while bedrooms are available for those who wish to linger a little longer....
